name: Drum Kits
description: Four playable multi-voice drum kits for the drum grid: each preset is a whole kit whose pieces are mapped to GM-style MIDI pitches. Studio Kit (14 pcs): layered acoustic kick/snare/toms with noise snaps and cymbal washes. Room Kit (12 pcs): looser jazz kit with brushed hats and a bell-forward ride. Electronic Kit (15 pcs): clean 24-bit modern electronic drums with a Reese Hat and Acid Tick. Psy Kit (24 pcs): the psy-rhythm one-shots repackaged as one kit - pitch map: 30 Deep Sub Drop, 31 Floor Tom, 33 Acid Kick, 34 Techno Kick, 35 808 Kick, 36 Sub Kick, 37 Rim Shot, 38 Tight Snare, 39 Clap, 40 Acid Snare, 41 Snare Tail, 42 Closed Hat, 43 Low Tom, 46 Open Hat, 47 Psy Tom, 49 Cymbal Wash, 50 High Tom, 53 Psy Ping, 57 Metallic, 60 Conga, 63 Hi Conga, 76 Tick, 81 Industrial, 82 Shaker. Pure synthesis, no samples.
author: Cadence

instruments.name: Studio Kit
instruments.description: 14-piece acoustic studio kit: sine/triangle drum bodies with pitch-dropping attacks, layered noise snaps for snare/clap/rim, brushed-top cymbals and a trashy China. GM-style pitches 36-55.

instruments.name: Room Kit
instruments.description: 12-piece looser jazz/room kit: soft stick attacks, warm long-decay toms, brushed hats with a lower darker wash and a bell-forward ride with a dedicated ride-bell piece. Pitches 36-53.

instruments.name: Electronic Kit
instruments.description: 15-piece modern electronic kit: punchy pitch-dropping kicks, tight layered snare and clap, crisp closed/pedal/open hats, FM-ish toms, a filtered cymbal sweep and two signature pieces - the detuned-saw Reese Hat and the squelchy Acid Tick. Clean 24-bit synthesis, pitches 35-51.

instruments.name: Psy Kit
instruments.description: 24-piece kit repackaged from the psy-rhythm one-shot presets: five kicks (sub, 808, techno, deep, acid), three snares, clap, rim, closed/open hats, cymbal wash, four toms, conga/hi-conga, metallic, industrial, tick, shaker and the eerie Psy Ping. Pitch map: 30 Deep Sub Drop, 31 Floor Tom, 33 Acid Kick, 34 Techno Kick, 35 808 Kick, 36 Sub Kick, 37 Rim Shot, 38 Tight Snare, 39 Clap, 40 Acid Snare, 41 Snare Tail, 42 Closed Hat, 43 Low Tom, 46 Open Hat, 47 Psy Tom, 49 Cymbal Wash, 50 High Tom, 53 Psy Ping, 57 Metallic, 60 Conga, 63 Hi Conga, 76 Tick, 81 Industrial, 82 Shaker.
